summary: United Maritime Corporation, a Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held November 4, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of Ms. Christina Anagnostara and Mr. Ioannis Kartsonas as Class A Directors serving until the 2029 Annual Meeting, and ratified Ernst & Young (Hellas) Certified Auditors Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal year 2026. No financial terms, transaction mechanics, advisors, or regulatory clocks are disclosed. This is a routine meeting-results disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies beyond ordinary governance continuity.
